_comment: Hand-reviewed additions to ExportCustoms for real, released cosmetics missing from warframe-public-export-plus. Each entry was individually verified (not bulk-imported) against live WFCD data - see src/lib/wfcdGapFill.js for the audit pipeline that surfaces candidates; this file is where a human-approved candidate actually gets shipped. Do not add entries here without verifying them individually first (see feedback_no_bulk_data_fixes memory).
